# Trexova

> > Trexova offers live online yoga and fitness classes across multiple styles including Ashtanga, Vinyasa, Power Yoga, Hatha, Yin, and Restorative Yoga, with specialized programs for weight loss, meditation, and wellness.

Trexova is an online wellness platform providing instructor-led yoga classes, functional training, meditation sessions, and nutrition guidance for students in India and beyond. The platform specializes in live interactive classes, yoga teacher training programs, and holistic health solutions combining physical exercise with mental wellness and dietary support.

- Ashtanga Yoga
- Vinyasa Yoga
- Power Yoga
- Hatha Yoga
- Yin Yoga
- Restorative Yoga
- Weight Loss Programs

- Mental Health and Wellness
- Respiratory Health

## Weight Loss and Fitness Programs

- [Yoga Exercise for Weight-Loss | Online Yoga for Weight-Loss - Trexova](https://www.trexova.com/in/weight~loss): Power yoga and weight-loss programs including Ashtanga and Vinyasa styles
